title: Masetto, senti un po'!
subtitle: Zerlina and Masetto: recitative from Don Giovanni, Act 1

passages.label: Masetto, senti un po'! … se non fosse lo scandalo, vorrei
Ma se colpa io non ho … ma poi fa pace (to the end)

licences.notes: Words as printed in the Schirmer vocal score (perchè, Ingrato!, quelche as one word, Fa and Ma with capitals; amazzami with one m, a misprint for ammazzami, kept as printed with the IPA of ammazzami as sung).

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), pages 104–105, the recitative between No. 11 and No. 12 (26 bars)
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung lines and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out. Secco recitative: the piano part is the printed chords; no performance marks are printed. The last bar (bar 26, Zerlina's pa-ce) is a printed one-beat bar, set as 1/4; it leads attacca into No. 12. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 77 (about 1:19), from the median length of five complete recordings (Fricsay 1958 1:10, Giulini 1959 1:01, Böhm 1977 1:22, Karajan 1985 1:23, Solti 1996 1:20; median 1:20), less 1.5 s of track silence, as sources/cosi/TEMPI.md does.
